input: Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_h8.text, /moves/knight_g8.text, or /moves/bishop_f8.text must also be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, since those agents have repeatedly gone off plan with amnesia or greed.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
